constraints.notes: ARO-SATIN 2026-10-26 phase 2. editable = crates/mega-evm/src/{evm,limit,access,system} only, minus the test-only modules the instruments are built from (test_utils/, external/test_utils.rs, external/hasher/: compiled only under the test-utils feature that the probe, the benches and state-test all turn on, so an edit there could move a measurement without moving production); the cfg(test) fence is unchanged. The forks (revm, op-revm) are out of scope. Differential = probes/satin_outcome_digest.py (satin-outcome-v2): the six whole-outcome digest runs of the execution-spec state tests (equivalence/satin/tight x Osaka main / Amsterdam devnet), the main release's blockchain tests through the block executor, a fence over every item of crates/mega-evm/src gated on test-utils or test (the unit tests included), and a second pass of the same seven runs with --json-witness folding in the read set: everything each transaction read below the journal (database accounts, codes, slots and block hashes; SALT buckets and Oracle slots the external environment answered). Each run's line count pinned (a short corpus is exit 2); a read-set run must print as many lines as its outcome run; the DIFF line carries both fingerprints, so reshaping the reads without changing the outcome is a rejection. test_full mirrors CI: workspace, release, locked, warnings denied. Terminal = bench lane on the four CodSpeed bench targets via mega-bench-reporter measure --instructions. codspeed_confirm on: every inner-loop accept is re-checked on those benches (cargo codspeed build/run, simulation mode) against the probe's per-row Ir before it may fold; disagreement freezes it (codspeed-unconfirmed). Probe rows = the 41 CodSpeed Satin rows by name (probes/codspeed_rowmap.py checks it), block/erc20_transfers included.
